### Workload structure and GPU activity
Solid edges show Karta component attribution. Dashed edges show replica-group membership. GPU readings are simulated; requested GPUs are not verified physical allocations.

Activity states require the separate GPU observer. Round panels require the old round simulator. Unavailable means those metrics are absent. The current generator creates workloads independently.

panels.title: Karta attribution structure
panels.description:
Live projection of Karta attribution metrics, not the full desired library tree or Kubernetes ownerReferences. Solid edges show component/instance attribution; dashed edges show the separate logical replica-group axis. Pod nodes are unique by namespace and Pod UID. workload nodes persist with zero mapped Pods. Missing children are not invented. Counts show mapped Pods, not desired replicas. workload color is workload-level GPU activity evidence only.

Optional input: GPU observer. These components are not installed in this demo. Missing telemetry is unavailable, not zero or idle.

panels.title: Measured GPU activity
panels.description:
Direct workload-level observer state. Low activity requires complete UID-proven coverage of all assigned GPU devices for the configured window; it is not application idleness or reclaimable capacity. This separate observer covers karta-metrics-workloads only; other namespaces have no GPU telemetry and no inferred no-GPU decision.

Optional input: GPU observer. These components are not installed in this demo. Missing telemetry is unavailable, not zero or idle.

targets.expr: sum((1 * (max by(namespace,workload_uid,state,reason)((workload_gpu_observer_state{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",source="synthetic",state="active"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(workload_gpu_observer_state{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",source="synthetic",state="active"}) < 45)) and on() (max(up{job="karta-workload-gpu-observer"}) == 1))) or (2 * (max by(namespace,workload_uid,state,reason)((workload_gpu_observer_state{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",source="synthetic",state="low_activity"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(workload_gpu_observer_state{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",source="synthetic",state="low_activity"}) < 45)) and on() (max(up{job="karta-workload-gpu-observer"}) == 1))) or (3 * (max by(namespace,workload_uid,state,reason)((workload_gpu_observer_state{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",source="synthetic",state="warming"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(workload_gpu_observer_state{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",source="synthetic",state="warming"}) < 45)) and on() (max(up{job="karta-workload-gpu-observer"}) == 1))) or (4 * (max by(namespace,workload_uid,state,reason)((workload_gpu_observer_state{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",source="synthetic",state="unknown"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(workload_gpu_observer_state{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",source="synthetic",state="unknown"}) < 45)) and on() (max(up{job="karta-workload-gpu-observer"}) == 1))) or (5 * (max by(namespace,workload_uid,state,reason)((workload_gpu_observer_state{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",source="synthetic",state="no_gpu"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(workload_gpu_observer_state{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",source="synthetic",state="no_gpu"}) < 45)) and on() (max(up{job="karta-workload-gpu-observer"}) == 1)))) or on() (label_replace(vector(6),"namespace","$namespace","",".*") unless on(namespace) label_replace(vector(1),"namespace","karta-metrics-workloads","",".*")) or on() vector(4)

panels.title: Simulated GPU utilization (max available)
panels.description: Fake GPU telemetry, not physical GPU work or proof of application activity. exported_namespace and exported_pod are normalized before the Pod-name join. Name reuse remains a limitation.

panels.title: Low evidence
panels.description:
Continuous valid low-activity evidence. Active values reset this timer; no inference is made from workload age. N/A requires a fresh observed No GPUs state; missing telemetry stays Unknown.

Optional input: GPU observer. These components are not installed in this demo. Missing telemetry is unavailable, not zero or idle.

targets.expr: (min(workload_gpu_observer_low_activity_observation_seconds{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid"} and (time() - timestamp(workload_gpu_observer_low_activity_observation_seconds{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid"}) < 45)) and on() (max(up{job="karta-workload-gpu-observer"}) == 1)) or on() (-1 * (max(max by(namespace,workload_uid,state,reason)((workload_gpu_observer_state{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",source="synthetic",state="no_gpu"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(workload_gpu_observer_state{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",source="synthetic",state="no_gpu"}) < 45)) and on() (max(up{job="karta-workload-gpu-observer"}) == 1))))

panels.title: Simulator intention
panels.description:
Desired scenario from the randomizer ConfigMap, never measured classification. Quiet targets 0-3%; active targets 60-95%. A partially applied round is not proof that every Pod changed.

Optional input: round simulator. These components are not installed in this demo. Missing telemetry is unavailable, not zero or idle.

targets.expr: (max(workload_gpu_demo_intent_info{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",scenario="quiet"} or (2 * workload_gpu_demo_intent_info{namespace="$namespace",workload_uid="$workload_uid",scenario="active"})) and on() ((max(workload_gpu_demo_metadata_healthy{namespace="$namespace"} and (time() - timestamp(workload_gpu_demo_metadata_healthy{namespace="$namespace"}) < 45)) == 1) and on() (max(up{job="karta-workload-gpu-observer"}) == 1))) or on() (4 * ((max(workload_gpu_demo_metadata_healthy{namespace="$namespace"} and (time() - timestamp(workload_gpu_demo_metadata_healthy{namespace="$namespace"}) < 45)) == 1) and on() (max(up{job="karta-workload-gpu-observer"}) == 1))) or vector(3)

panels.description:
Progress of the current ten-minute demo round. The measured low-activity timer is separate.

Optional input: round simulator. These components are not installed in this demo. Missing telemetry is unavailable, not zero or idle.

targets.expr: clamp((time() - max(workload_gpu_demo_round_started_timestamp_seconds{namespace="$namespace"})) / (max(workload_gpu_demo_round_ends_timestamp_seconds{namespace="$namespace"}) - max(workload_gpu_demo_round_started_timestamp_seconds{namespace="$namespace"})),0,1) and on() ((max(workload_gpu_demo_metadata_healthy{namespace="$namespace"} and (time() - timestamp(workload_gpu_demo_metadata_healthy{namespace="$namespace"}) < 45)) == 1) and on() (max(up{job="karta-workload-gpu-observer"}) == 1))
